extDesc.message: Bilingual subtitles for YouTube — original and translation in one non-overlapping layer.

disclaimer.message: Not affiliated with YouTube or Google.

backendTipHtml.message:
Auto: uses YouTube's whole-track translation whenever the video supports it, and switches to smart sentences when it doesn't.
Whole-track: YouTube's own translation; aligned and never rate-limited.
Smart sentences: rebuilds fragmented captions into full sentences, then translates via Google's free endpoint — try it when the whole-track wording reads badly; heavy use may be briefly rate-limited, and the extension slows down and retries on its own.
Your own key: sends the rebuilt sentences to your own LLM or DeepL key for the best wording. You pay the provider directly; the key stays on this machine.

backendGtxHint.message: Uses Google's free endpoint — heavy use may be briefly rate-limited; the extension paces itself and retries automatically.

backendStatusLimited.message: Rate-limited by the translation endpoint — slowing down and retrying automatically. Already-translated lines keep working.

backendStatusSame.message: This video's subtitles are already in your target language — nothing to translate.

posHint.message: You can also drag the subtitle box on the video

handleTitle.message: Drag to move · double-click to reset

handleAria.message: Drag to move subtitles, double-click to reset

exportNoTrans.message: No translation available for this video — try the Whole-track engine or another target language.

exportNoCues.message: No downloadable subtitles — play a few seconds so captions load, then try again.

exportNotYoutube.message: Open a YouTube video page to export.

exportFailed.message: Export failed — refresh the page and try again.

trackWarnDubOnly.message: Heads up: this video only has AI-dubbed auto captions (no original-language track), so the bilingual subtitles may not match the audio.

byoKeyCleared.message: The key stored on this machine has been removed.

byoLocalHint.message: The key stays in this browser, on this machine — it is never uploaded. Subtitle text goes only to the provider you picked.

byoErrNoKey.message: Enter an API key first — the link below opens the provider's key page.

byoErrNoModel.message: This provider needs a model name typed in.

byoErrBadBaseUrl.message: The API base URL must be a full https:// address.

byoErrNoPerm.message: Without permission to reach that API host the extension cannot connect.

byoErrAuth.message: The key was rejected (401/403) — check that it was copied in full and is active.

byoErrLimited.message: The provider is rate-limiting — slowing down and retrying automatically.

byoErrQuota.message: This key is out of quota for the current period.

byoErrBadRequest.message: The endpoint refused the request — the model name or base URL may be wrong.

byoErrBadShape.message: The model did not answer line by line as asked, and smaller retries failed too — try another model.

byoErrReasoning.message: That model returned only its chain of thought and no translation — pick a non-thinking model.

byoErrNetfail.message: Cannot reach that endpoint (network or regional restriction).

byoErrUnsupportedTarget.message: This provider has no target for your chosen language — change the language or the engine.

byoErrFailed.message: Connection failed. Try again in a moment.

optIntro.message: Pick a provider and paste your own API key. The key stays on this machine, and subtitle text goes only to the provider you choose.

optModelsFailed.message: Could not list models — type the model name instead.

optNoModelsYet.message: No model list yet — fetch one with your key, or just type the name.

optAfterSetup.message: When you are done here, open the extension popup and set Engine to "Your own key".

optTrademark.message: All provider names and logos are trademarks of their respective owners. This extension is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any of them; the marks are shown only to identify the API you picked.

startIntro.message: Three things. You do not have to set anything up to use it.

startS1Body.message: Any YouTube video that has subtitles: the two lines appear on their own.

startS2Body.message: Hold the grip at the top-left of the subtitle box and drag it anywhere. Double-click the grip to put it back.

startS2Alt.message: Player diagram: a six-dot grip at the top-left corner of the subtitle box, dragging it to another position

startS3Body.message: Add your own API key: whole-sentence translation, and SRT export for a whole video.

aboutIntro.message: What this is, and where your text goes.

aboutBlurb.message: A second subtitle line for YouTube: the original on one line, the translation on the other, with the font, colour and position up to you. Open source, free, no ads.

aboutPrivacy.message: We have no server and collect no statistics. Subtitle text goes only to the translation service you pick; with your own key, the key is stored on this computer only.

exportUsesYouTube.message: The download uses YouTube's own whole-track translation — free, and it does not spend your API key.

exportUseByo.message: Translate with my own key (closer match, spends quota)

exportByoNote.message: The whole track will be translated by your provider with your key. You will see an estimate before anything is sent.

exportConfirm.message: Translate $N$ subtitle lines with $NAME$ — roughly $REQ$ requests against your own quota. The whole track leaves your browser for that provider; during playback only the parts you actually watch are ever sent.

exportPartial.message: $N$ chunk(s) fell back to YouTube's translation

ftFeedback.message: Send feedback or report a bug

ftReview.message: Rate it on the Chrome Web Store

optNeedKey.message: No key yet — this provider cannot be used until you add one.

optBaseHint.message: A base URL or a full endpoint both work, e.g. https://example.com/v1 or https://example.com/v1/chat/completions.

startS1Alt.message: Player diagram: an original line and a translated line sit near the bottom of the picture

startS3Alt.message: Comparison: the free engine translates one sentence in pieces, your own key understands it whole and splits it back

startNoSubs.message: Click the CC button at the bottom right of the player, or try another video — live streams and music videos often have none at all.

langsIntro.message: Which languages the popup offers you to translate into.

langsKeptHint.message: These appear in the popup's target-language menu. Keep at least one.

langsMoreHint.message: Press + to add one. The free engines cover all of them; DeepL is missing a few and will say so rather than guess.

langsAllAdded.message: Every language is already in your list.

langsSwitched.message: That one was in use, so the target is now $NAME$
